messages:
maya: quick flag — after the RBAC tightening rollout to eu-west this morning, apac-edge services are seeing sporadic TLS handshake failures. KMS shows a few decrypt denies around the same time. Anyone oncall?

sanjeev: on it. can you paste the failing service and an example request id?

maya: service=apac-ingress-proxy, req_id=req_0a1b2c3d. errors in proxy logs: `TLS handshaking: certificate verify failed` and `client cert unknown`. KMS log: `DecryptDenied: principal not authorized`.

leah: hmm — RBAC change yesterday limited keystore access to `infra:keystore/read` for non-prod roles. did we accidentally tighten a role that's used by edge cert fetchers?

kevin: I pushed that change. The intent was to scope a handful of deploy bots, but I may have used the wrong role label. Investigating shortcuts I took during the rollout.

maya: @kevin if the cert fetcher sidecar lost access it would fail to unwrap private keys, leading to handshake fails. Can you check the rotator/sidecar SA permissions?

kevin: checking now — `kubectl get sa -n apac` shows `cert-rotator-sa` bound only to `infra:keystore/read:limited` in apac cluster, while eu has full `infra:keystore/read`. I probably forgot the apac exception.

rotator-bot: [automation] attempted key unwrap for apac-ingress-proxy/rotator at 2026-03-23T10:15:12Z -> KMS: DecryptDenied (principal arn:aws:sts::123456789:assumed-role/cert-rotator-sa)

leah: ok — quick fix: add the apac binding to match eu and restart the rotator sidecar. Then confirm handshakes. Also audit-log gap: I saw sparse KMS audit entries for the first 30s of the incident window. We should capture the full window for RCA.

kevin: applying policy patch to apac now (yaml snip):
```
apiVersion: rbac.redwood.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: cert-rotator-keystore-bind
  namespace: apac
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: cert-rotator-sa
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: infra-keystore-read
```

kevin: patched and restarting rotator pods.

maya: after restart, 2/3 rotator instances re-established keys; one is still failing with `403 KMS decrypt`.

kevin: that instance had an older kubelet token — redeploying fixed it. rolling restart done.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-23-1052 created. Impact: intermittent TLS handshake failures in apac for ~7m. Initial mitigation: RBAC patch to restore keystore read and rotator restart.

leah: follow-ups: 1) patch the RBAC rollout job to include region matrix so future changes don't omit clusters. 2) add an automated post-rollout smoke that checks mTLS handshake to origin for each region. 3) add KMS audit log retention alerting for any gaps >10s in the most-recent stream.

maya: +1 on post-rollout smoke. also let's add an eval in Redwood Optimize to detect parity regressions between regional deployments for keystore perms.

sanjeev: for RCA I want: exact RBAC diff, cert-rotator logs, KMS audit slice (10:13:00–10:20:00Z), and proxy handshake traces for req_0a1b2c3d series. I'll start the log pull.

kevin: apologies for the break — will revert my ad-hoc rollout script and update with a region-check.

leah: security note: consider tightening the KMS key policy to require service identity assertion rather than broad role ARN bindings. That reduces blast radius if an RBAC binding is misapplied.

maya: agree. Also let's run a quick inventory: which services fetch private key material directly vs use cached prefix/KV? we should minimize unwraps.

kevin: I'll compile a short list and add to the follow-up ticket.

maya: thanks team. small action list in the incident ticket: RBAC rollout fix, post-rollout smoke, KMS audit retention alert, rotator redeploy docs, and a short design spike on key-policy tightening.

leah: tagging for owners: @kevin (RBAC patch + rollout job), @sanjeev (RCA logs), @maya (post-rollout smoke + eval). :white_check_mark:
